===Calendar changes===
[[File:Croatia Rally 2021 Ban Jelacic Square.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[Croatia Rally]] returned to the championship after being held as a [[European Rally Championship]] event in 2025.]]
*The [[Croatia Rally]] returned to the championship after missing the {{WRC|2025}} season, replacing the [[Central European Rally]].<ref>{{Cite news|first=Tom|last=Howard|url=https://www.autosport.com/wrc/news/croatia-strikes-new-deal-to-rejoin-wrc-in-2026/10673079/|title=Croatia strikes new deal to rejoin WRC in 2026|work=[[Autosport]]|publisher=[[Motorsport Network]]|date=15 November 2024|access-date=16 November 2024}}</ref> The rally featured new headquarters in [[Rijeka]], instead of [[Zagreb]] and a brand new set of mixed tarmac stages.<ref>{{Cite news|first=Toni|last=Heinonen|url=https://rallyjournal.com/croatias-wrc-rally-set-for-a-complete-overhaul/|title=Croatia's WRC rally set for a complete overhaul|website=rallyjournal.com|date=12 December 2025|access-date=16 December 2025}}</ref>
*The Italian Rally and [[Rally Japan]] swapped calendar slots, and the new [[Rally di Roma Capitale]] was confirmed to replace the [[Rally Italia Sardegna]] from {{WRC|2027}} onwards.<ref>{{Cite news|first=Luke|last=Barry|url=https://dirtfish.com/rally/wrc/wrc-2026-calendar-confirmed/|title=WRC 2026 calendar confirmed|work=[[DirtFish]]|date=31 July 2025|access-date=1 August 2025}}</ref>
*The organisers of the [[Acropolis Rally]] announced a change of its headquarters, with [[Loutraki]] serving as the new base after five years in [[Lamia (city)|Lamia]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.acropolisrally.gr/2025/en/category-media/news/general-en/847-a-new-chapter-for-eko-acropolis-rally-greece-loutraki-to-host-the-2026-edition|title=A New Chapter for EKO Acropolis Rally Greece: Loutraki to host the 2026 edition|work=[[Acropolis Rally]]|date=15 October 2025|access-date=19 October 2025}}</ref>
*The [[Rally Saudi Arabia]] was set to hold [[2026 Rally Saudi Arabia|the season finale]], but it was removed from the calendar in September due to the [[2026 Iran war]].<ref>{{Cite news|first=Tom|last=Howard|title=Evans favourite to become WRC champion as Rally Saudi Arabia is cancelled|url=https://www.autosport.com/wrc/news/wrc-cancels-saudi-arabia-finale/10856625/|work=[[Autosport|autosport.com]]|publisher=[[Motorsport Network]]|date=17 September 2026|access-date=18 September 2026}}</ref> An all-gravel round in Catalonia, Spain was reportedly mooted as a replacement, however this did not materialise as the deadline for its confirmation was not met.<ref name="SAU-removal"/>
